definitions.explanation: A message sent between computers or mobile devices over a network; the full Japanese term for email. Commonly shortened to just メール in everyday speech.

examples.japanese: {電子|でんし}メール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
{電子|でんし}メール⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}して→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please submit the documents by email.

examples.japanese: お⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ→問い合わせ：06131_toiawase⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{電子|でんし}メール⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: For inquiries, please contact us by email or telephone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{電子|でんし}メール⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦チャット→チャット：04436_chatto⟧⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, more people use chat apps rather than email to stay in touch.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧ (electronic) + ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧ (mail, from English). The formal, full-length term for email, used in official notices, legal documents, business forms, and signage — places where the casual shortened form ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧ would feel too informal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電子|でんし}メール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to send an email
- {電子|でんし}メール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to receive an email
- {電子|でんし}メールアドレス: email address
- {電子|でんし}メール⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧: to contact by email
- {電子|でんし}メールマガジン: email newsletter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧: mail / email — the everyday shortened form; far more common in conversation. Ambiguously refers to email, SMS, or messaging depending on context.
- Eメール: e-mail — another written form, seen on forms and older materials.
- ⟦メッセージ→メッセージ：03828_messeeji⟧: message — broader; includes chat app messages, SMS, etc.

USAGE:
In conversation, simply say ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧. Use {電子|でんし}メール in formal writing, government documents, or when explicitly distinguishing email from other kinds of messages (such as postal mail, SMS, or in-app chat). Historically the formal term was needed to distinguish email from ⟦{郵便|ゆうびん}→郵便：03803_yuubin⟧ (postal mail), but as email became ubiquitous the short form took over.
